حَدَقٌ : see حَدَقَةٌ, in three place. ―
-b2- Also The [fruit of the] بَاذِنْجَان [q. v.: accord. to Forskål (Flora Ægypt. Arab., p. 47), solanum cordatum]: (IAar, Az, K:) [a coll. gen. n.:] n. un. with ة: likened to the blacks of the eyes of the [species of antelope called] مَهَا: in the handwriting of 'Alee Ibn-Hamzeh, written حذق, with the dotted ذ; but this is not known. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
